sanskrit: manāyyai tantuṃ prathamaṃ paśced anyā atanvata | tan nārīḥ pra bravīmi vaḥ sādhvīr vaḥ santūrvarīḥ ||
english: First let her observe the thread for the loom-peg, then let others stretch it out. This I declare to you, O women: may you be skilled, may you be the prolific weavers.

sanskrit: sādhur vas tantur bhavatu sādhur otur atho vṛtā | atho horvarīr yūyaṃ prātar voḍheva dhāvata ||
english: Let your warp-thread be proper, proper the weft, and proper the twisted yarn. And you swift ones — run at dawn like a bride being escorted.

sanskrit: khargalā iva patvarīr apām ugram ivāyanam | patantu patvarīr iva- -urvarīḥ sādhunā pathā ||
english: Swift as the khargalā-bird, like the fierce current of waters — let the swift ones, the prolific weavers, fly along by the good path.

sanskrit: avācyau totudyete todenāśvatarāv iva | pra stomam urvarīṇāṃ śaśayānām astāviṣam ||
english: The two prods that prick them prod like a goad upon a pair of mules. I have proclaimed the praise of the prolific weavers who ply their craft with speed.

sanskrit: nārī pañcamayūkhaṃ sūtravat kṛṇutaṃ vasu | ariṣṭo asya vastā prendra vāsa utau tira ||
english: O woman, work the wealth into the five-pegged loom like a strand of thread. May the wearer of this garment be unharmed; O Indra, drive the garment through the loom as well.

sanskrit: śāsa itthā mahām̐ asy amitraghāto adbhutaḥ | na yasya hanyate sakhā na jīyate kadā cana ||
english: Command thus — you are great, the wondrous slayer of foes, he whose companion is never slain, never conquered at any time.

sanskrit: vi rakṣo vi mṛdho jahi vi vṛtrasya hanū ruja | vi manyum indra vṛtrahann amitrasyābhidāsataḥ ||
english: Smite the demon asunder, smite down the adversaries, break apart the jaws of Vṛtra. Shatter the wrath, O Indra, O slayer of Vṛtra, of the foe who assaults us.

sanskrit: vi na indra vi mṛdho jahi nīcā yaccha pṛtanyataḥ | adhamaṃ gamayā tamo yo asmām̐ abhidāsati ||
english: For us, O Indra, smite down the adversaries; press the one who fights against us downward. Send into the lowest darkness him who attacks us.

sanskrit: svastidā viśāṃ patir vṛtrahā vimṛdho vaśī | vṛṣendraḥ pura etu naḥ somapā abhayaṃkaraḥ ||
english: The giver of well-being, lord of the clans, slayer of Vṛtra, crusher of adversaries, the sovereign — may Indra the bull, the drinker of soma, the maker of fearlessness, march at our fore.

sanskrit: apendra dviṣato mano 'pa jijyāsato vadham | vi mahac charma yaccha varīyo yāvayā vadham ||
english: O Indra, drive away the mind of the hateful, drive away the weapon of him who seeks to conquer. Extend wide and broad shelter; ward off the weapon.

sanskrit: ayaṃ yo 'titaro maṇis tenāti tara duśyasaḥ | sapatnān dviṣato maṇe pra ṇudasva pṛtanyataḥ ||
english: This amulet which crosses over — by it cross beyond the ill-wishers. O amulet, thrust away the rival foes, the hateful, those who fight against us.

sanskrit: pra ṇudasva pra sahasva sapatnān dviṣato maṇe | tarābhimātiṃ duśyasāṃ varco bhaṅgdhi pṛtanyatām ||
english: Thrust away, overwhelm the rival foes, the hateful, O amulet. Cross beyond the enmity of the ill-wishers; break the vitality of those who fight against us.

sanskrit: varco jahi manyuṃ jahy ākūtiṃ dviṣatāṃ maṇe | devo yo 'titaro maṇis tenāti tara dhūrvataḥ ||
english: Strike down the vitality, strike down the wrath, strike down the hostile intent of the enemies, O amulet. The divine amulet which crosses over — by it cross beyond those who seek to harm.

sanskrit: ye dhūrvanti ye druhyanti ye dviṣanti pṛtanyataḥ | sarvān sapatnāṃs te maṇir ni manyuṃ dviṣatas karat ||
english: Those who injure, those who act treacherously, those who hate and fight against us — may your amulet lay low all those rivals; may it lay low the wrath of the enemy.

sanskrit: tava citte tava vrate tavaivādhaspadaṃ carān | devo yo 'titaro maṇis tenāti tara duśyasaḥ ||
english: May they move within your thought, within your ordinance, under your very foot. The divine amulet which crosses over — by it cross beyond the ill-wishers.
